subject.title: Will Browser automation get my account in trouble with OpenAI?

question: Should Oracle publish current account-risk guidance for ChatGPT browser automation, or treat the older same-topic support answer as still sufficient?
rationale: Source inspection can describe Oracle's browser behavior and guards, but it cannot safely decide OpenAI account enforcement risk or the reassurance level maintainers want to publish.

options.title: Post cautious current guidance
options.body: Answer publicly without legal guarantees, describe browser mode as experimental/operationally sensitive, and point risk-averse users to API mode or manual paste; optionally follow with a short FAQ note.

options.title: Close as covered by the prior answer
options.body: If maintainers consider https://github.com/steipete/oracle/issues/96 still current enough, close with that link and a short explanation.

options.title: Hold for policy clarity
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers have a current policy source or decide not to publish a project stance.

recommendation.title: Post cautious current guidance
recommendation.body: Answer publicly without legal guarantees, describe browser mode as experimental/operationally sensitive, and point risk-averse users to API mode or manual paste; optionally follow with a short FAQ note.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete answered the prior same-topic support issue and has the strongest browser-mode ownership signal in the checkout history.
